USD, whole dollars (model.scale = 1). Verified against June 2026 revenue ($13,164,599.73) and the Approved Stabilization Budget's own June 2026 figure, same unit; no '$ in thousands' caption anywhere in the source workbooks.

Actuals only -- company-prepared monthly reporting packages (Successor Reporting), unaudited. No proforma/budget/forecast columns included. Every monthly package's own 'Status' tab through June 2026 marks the P&L/BS/CF as PROVISIONAL (TDR framework, instrument-level 10% modification test, CODI, Section 382, and goodwill interim reassessment all remain open) -- successor Balance Sheet, gain/loss, and debt carrying-value figures could still restate once those workpapers conclude.
Sep 2024 through Jun 2026 (22 months), matching every monthly subfolder present in Successor Reporting (Archive/<YYYY-MM>/ for Sep 2024-May 2026; <YYYY>/<MM>/ for Jun 2026), continuous, no gaps.

One monthly.xlsx package per reporting period (Successor Reporting is a continuously-used MONTHLY folder despite its name, spanning both the predecessor/legacy and successor eras). Each month's own package is a single-period snapshot (no hidden multi-month columns, no separate consolidated by-month/YTD file exists anywhere in the deal folder) -- so each ISO month's figures are sourced to that month's own monthly.xlsx (see source-map.json for the exact file per statement per month).

Full scan performed: compared every month's own package against (a) any other package claiming to cover the same period and (b) any consolidated/by-month/YTD file -- neither exists anywhere in Successor Reporting or the wider Asteron deal folder for this borrower (unlike the Nemeris original/corrected-pair pattern). Each of the 22 months is reported exactly once, by exactly one file. Result: ZERO restatements found. restatements.json is written empty (schema present, zero entries).

'Cost of Patient Services' and 'Gross Profit' do NOT exist verbatim on the borrower's own Income Statement (it goes straight from Revenue and four direct-cost lines to 'Reported EBITDA'). Per borrower-config.json paths._model_lines_construction_note, these two rows are INSERTED as live formulas: Cost of Patient Services = SUM(Direct clinical labor, Contract labor, Medical supplies, Other patient service costs) [already-negative lines]; Gross Profit = Revenue + Cost of Patient Services. Independently re-verified against June 2026 to the penny: Revenue 13,164,599.73 + Cost of Patient Services (8,754,304.34) = Gross Profit 4,410,295.39; Gross Profit - Occupancy and site costs 1,557,912.45 - Corporate and administrative costs 1,304,641.66 = 1,547,741.28 = Reported EBITDA, tying exactly. The same two formulas were checked to foot for all 22 months with zero exceptions (see validation notes below).

Per build convention, 'Reported EBITDA' and 'Net income' are live formulas (Reported EBITDA = Gross Profit + Occupancy and site costs + Corporate and administrative costs; Net income = Reported EBITDA + Depreciation + Cash interest + Debt issuance cost amortization + Restructuring advisory expense + Income tax expense + Bridge upfront fee + Goodwill impairment), not hardcoded copies of the source subtotal -- both tie to the source's own printed subtotal in all 22 months to the penny, confirming the source data foots throughout the predecessor / legacy / exit-amendment / A&R eras alike.

Per covenant-spec.json#/definitions/EBITDA, compute.ebitda_bridge = 'Reported EBITDA' -- the model's own single pinned EBITDA row, taken AS PARSED (no add-back folded in). covenant-spec.json's step7_signoff explicitly EXCLUDES the constant $553,353.26/month gap between this Reported EBITDA and the borrower's own certified 'Covenant EBITDA' (Covenant Calculation.xlsx TTM Detail), because no executed document supports that add-back in words. This EBITDA bridge is therefore NOT provisional in the sense of 'no covenant spec' -- it is the spec-directed definition -- but the reader should know the FCCR covenant (the only covenant that reads this EBITDA) runs materially below the borrower's own certified figure as a structural, documented, and currently-immaterial-because-suspended gap.
Covenant-support rows -- CERTIFICATE OVERRIDE (per covenant-spec.json step7_signoff 'amortization_day_count_approximation')

'Facility Cash Interest Expense' and 'Facility Scheduled Debt Principal Payments' are the two rows debt-service-spec.json's covenant_support_rows names for Fixed_Charges. debt-service-schedule.json (generated engine output) only models the CURRENT A&R facility from its 2026-03-31 funding forward, and is known to use a flat/approximate day-count and amortization-base convention that does NOT reproduce the borrower's certified figures even within its own modeled range (documented in debt-service-spec.json's day_count.ambiguities: e.g. generated June 2026 cash interest 423,725.00 vs. certified 424,150.43). Per the covenant-spec's step7_signoff decision, BOTH rows are instead populated for ALL 22 months directly from the borrower's own CERTIFIED Portfolio Monitoring/<quarter>/Covenant Calculation.xlsx 'TTM Detail' exhibits (Cash interest / Principal columns), which -- because six overlapping quarterly certificates (2025-Q1 through 2026-Q2) together span 2024-04 through 2026-06 continuously -- cover every one of this model's 22 months with ZERO gaps and ZERO cross-quarter conflicts (every month that appears in more than one quarter's TTM Detail carries an identical figure to the penny). The generated debt-service-schedule.json was therefore NOT used as a fallback source for any month in this build -- certified figures alone were sufficient for the model's full Sep 2024-Jun 2026 range. Note the certified figures span the predecessor (11.50%/0.70%-month), legacy (same economics), Exit Amendment bridge (11.50% interest-only, hence Principal = 0.00 for Dec 2025-Mar 2026), and A&R (10.00%/0.10%-month, effective Apr 2026) facilities in turn -- each period's own contractual debt service, not a single facility's figure held constant. No non-facility scheduled debt (vehicle loans, SBA notes, etc.) is disclosed anywhere in the deal folder for this borrower, so nothing is added to the principal row beyond the certified facility figure.

Per covenant-spec.json accounting_basis and borrower-config.json paths._restructuring_timeline_note, the successor balance sheet (Apr 2026 forward per borrower-config.json analysis.basis_breaks) uses CARRYOVER (historical-cost) accounting, NOT a fresh-start/revalued basis -- confirmed against the IC Memo's 'ACCOUNTING STATUS' section. TDR framework selection, the instrument-level 10% modification test, CODI, and Section 382 conclusions all remain PENDING as of the June 2026 package; successor Balance Sheet figures could still restate.
Balance Sheet -- no current/non-current subtotal, no inventory

Per borrower-config.json analysis_lines._omitted_note: the Balance Sheet carries a flat asset/liability list with no Total Current Assets/Total Current Liabilities subtotal and no inventory line (healthcare-services business); neither is invented here. current_ratio/working-capital/DIO ratios will be suppressed downstream with a disclosed reason.

FY2024/FY2025/2026-YTD columns are PERIOD-END (spot) snapshots for every BALANCE/stock-type row (asset/liability/equity lines, Total assets/liabilities/equity, Liabilities and equity, Balance Check, and -- in the Debt & Equity Roll-Forward block -- Ending gross debt, Unamortized debt issuance costs, and Carrying debt), consistent with balance-sheet convention (summing point-in-time balances across months is not meaningful). FLOW-type rows (Draws, Scheduled principal, Predecessor payoff, Legacy facility funding, Debt converted to preferred, and both covenant-support rows Facility Cash Interest Expense / Facility Scheduled Debt Principal Payments) instead SUM over the period, matching the Income Statement and Cash Flow Statement convention, since a period total is what a Fixed-Charges-style coverage figure needs. 'Beginning gross debt' uses the FIRST month of the period (a beginning-of-period spot value) rather than the last. JUDGMENT CALL: assembling-rules.md's 'Include FY / YTD total columns (SUM formulas)' bullet is written generically; this build read it as applying literally to flow statements (IS, CF) and to the Balance Sheet's own flow-type memo rows, while treating true balance/stock rows as period-end spot references rather than sums (summing a balance across months has no meaning). The alternative reading -- SUM every BS row literally -- would produce a nonsensical 'FY2025 Total Assets' equal to twelve months of asset balances added together; this build's reading matches the prior canonical build for this plugin (Nemeris Field Systems) exactly.

Reproduces the borrower's own 'Debt and Equity' tab (Beginning gross debt, Draws, Scheduled principal, Predecessor payoff, Legacy facility funding, Debt converted to preferred, Ending gross debt, Unamortized debt issuance costs, Carrying debt) as supplementary detail beyond the core Balance Sheet -- verified to foot exactly in all 22 months (Ending gross debt = SUM of the six components above it; Carrying debt = Ending gross debt + Unamortized debt issuance costs) and verified to tie exactly to the Balance Sheet's own 'Funded debt, carrying amount' line every month. The March 2026 exit-capitalization exchange is visible directly in this roll-forward: Draws +$7,000,000.00 (new-money term debt), Debt converted to preferred -$16,910,820.62 (predecessor/legacy debt exchanged into Series A preferred equity), Ending gross debt $51,000,000.00 (the reinstated $44,000,000.00 + new-money $7,000,000.00).

The borrower's 'Cash Flow' tab delivers a full month every period (Beginning cash, Cash from operations, Cash from investing, Cash from financing, Ending cash) -- used AS REPORTED, not derived. Verified continuous and self-consistent across all 22 months: each month's Beginning cash equals the prior month's Ending cash (first model month, Sep 2024, Beginning cash = $9,352,790.80, carried forward from the package's own figure), Ending cash = Beginning + CFO + CFI + CFF exactly, and Ending cash ties to the Balance Sheet's own Cash line exactly, every month. The source statement is presented only at this four-line summary level (no line-item detail, no Net-Income-to-CFO reconciliation) -- none is invented; a 'Memo: Net income (per Income Statement)' row is carried for reference only, not as a tie-out, since the source discloses no reconciling detail to check it against.
Restatement / tie-out materiality threshold: the greater of $25,000 or 1% of the line, per assembling-rules.md standard. Not triggered this build -- zero restatements found.

Balance sheet balances every month (Balance Check row = 0, verified for all 22 months pre-build in source data and reproduced live in the workbook's own formulas). Income-statement subtotals foot (Cost of Patient Services, Gross Profit, Reported EBITDA, Net income all derive correctly from detail lines, verified for all 22 months, zero exceptions). Cash Flow ties to the Balance Sheet (cash) by construction every month via its own memo tie-out row. Debt & Equity Roll-Forward ties to the Balance Sheet's Funded debt, carrying amount line every month.

Built with openpyxl; formula cells recalculated (cached values populated) via headless LibreOffice as the LAST write, per assembling-rules.md. Gated with references/validate_model.py before becoming canonical.
